captures.description: BODMER LAB, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The term Bodmer Lab most commonly refers to one of three distinct entities depending on the context': the Geneva digital library and archives (University of Geneva, the Martin Bodmer Foundation, the Fondation Ernst and Lucie Schmidheiny; rare books, manuscripts, 'world literature spanning 3,000 years', the Bodmer Papyri), Rolf Bodmer's cardiovascular laboratory at Sanford Burnham Prebys (Drosophila), and the Bodmer Laboratories of the University of Salford (named after Sir Walter Bodmer). Nine cards across the three.

atoms.evidence: A research and digitization project partnering the [University of Geneva]
